say:10:1027112007:0.text: Sorry, Damian... we didn't realize it was your friend. We thought it was a wild creature trying to steal the fruit...
say:10:1027112007:0.source_cn: 对不起，达米安，我们不知道它是你的朋友，还以为它是想要...

say:11:1027112008:0.text: Ah, you mean the glowfly fruit? It's for Petal.
say:11:1027112008:0.source_cn: 啊，你说那些萤瓤果吗，那些本来就是给一叶准备的。

choice_prompt:12:1027112008.text: Ah, you mean the glowfly fruit? It's for Petal.

say:13:1027112009:0.text: Yes, Petal only eats sweet fruit and drinks spring water. She would never hurt anyone!

say:14:1027112012:0.text: When I was chased by the Thorned Guards, Petal dragged me into the bushes to protect me. It's thanks to her that I'm safe.
say:14:1027112012:0.source_cn: 之前外出的时候，荆棘卫队追着我不放，是一叶把我拽进草丛...

say:15:1027112013:0.text: But it was all so crazy, and we got separated in the labyrinth. When we met up again, she barely escaped from the Thorned Guards.
say:15:1027112013:0.source_cn: 可那时太混乱了，我们进入迷宫之后就走散了。再见面的时候...

say:16:1027112014:0.text: She was so badly hurt that I had to find a place for her to heal. Luckily, she's all better now.
say:16:1027112014:0.source_cn: 她满身是伤，也没地方去，我只能找个安全的地方让她养伤，...

say:17:1027112015:0.text: Only... I never expected her to have such a huge appetite.
